responsibility: Defines the shared Cygwin/MinGW target option table consumed by GCC’s option-generation machinery for Windows GNU targets. It declares PE/Windows-specific switches such as console vs. GUI subsystem selection, DLL code generation, MinGW thread support, dllimport handling quirks, writable relocated rdata, aligned commons, and stack-executable control for nested functions, providing the canonical metadata that drives target flags, driver behavior, and user-visible option parsing.
